name: coachgrow
description: Manage a coaching business in CoachGrow: students, lessons, leads, bookings, and site changes you approve.

interface.longDescription:
CoachGrow is business software for sports and lesson coaches. This plugin lets a coach manage that business from ChatGPT: look up students, lessons, leads, and bookings, and get everyday admin work done without opening the dashboard.

Ask about students and their prepaid lessons, upcoming lessons, leads, packages, discount codes, reviews, site traffic, and how you rank in search. Ask for changes such as a discount code, new availability, time off, a lesson proposal, a site edit, or a Google post.

Every change is shown to you first and happens only after you say yes. Many changes can be undone from the same chat. ChatGPT cannot refund, pay out, or charge anyone, cannot message many students at once, and never sees student phone numbers or emails. You can disconnect at any time in CoachGrow Settings.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on in CoachGrow today?
How many lessons does Sam have left?
Make a 15% off code for new students.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the public address of the coach's site. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Look up one student's prepaid lesson balance.
positive.prompt: How many lessons does Sam have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Sam's prepaid lessons left. Asks which Sam if more than one matches. Shows no phone number or email.

positive.prompt: How am I ranking on Google for lessons in my city?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the coach's current search positions and when they were checked.

positive.description: Create a discount code with a preview and an approval.
positive.prompt: Make a 15% off code for new students.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the code, the amount, and where it applies, then waits. After the coach says yes, applies it once and confirms.
Turns the code off using the undo reference from the receipt and confirms.

negative.description: Refunds are not available. The plugin says so and points to CoachGrow. It calls no write tool.
Messages to many students are not available. The plugin says so and does not approximate it.
negative.prompt: Text all my students about my new package.

negative.description: Contact details are never returned. The plugin says they stay in CoachGrow.
negative.prompt: What's Sam's phone number and email?

publication.release_notes: First release. Read live CoachGrow account data and make approved changes with preview, apply, and undo.
